WITH tenure_quartiles AS (
    SELECT 
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY tenureyrs) AS tenure_quartile
    FROM core_record
),
customer_cohorts AS (
    SELECT 
        cr.clientref, 
        tq.tenure_quartile AS cohort_quarter
    FROM core_record cr
    JOIN tenure_quartiles tq ON TRUE
),
digital_natives AS (
    SELECT 
        bat.bankexpref, 
        CASE 
            WHEN cidb.chaninvdatablock->>'onlineuse' = 'High' 
            AND cidb.chaninvdatablock->>'mobileuse' = 'High' THEN TRUE 
            ELSE FALSE 
        END AS is_digital_native
    FROM bank_and_transactions bat
    JOIN expenses_and_assets eaa ON bat.bankexpref = eaa.expemplref
    JOIN employment_and_income eai ON eaa.expemplref = eai.emplcoreref
    JOIN core_record cr ON eai.emplcoreref = cr.coreregistry
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT chaninvdatablock
    ) AS cidb
),
engagement_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        cr.clientref, 
        -- Assuming 'chanusescore' is the engagement score
        cah.chanusescore AS engagement_score
    FROM core_record cr
    JOIN employment_and_income eai ON cr.coreregistry = eai.emplcoreref
    JOIN expenses_and_assets eaa ON eai.emplcoreref = eaa.expemplref
    JOIN bank_and_transactions bat ON eaa.expemplref = bat.bankexpref
    JOIN credit_and_compliance cac ON bat.bankexpref = cac.compbankref
    JOIN credit_accounts_and_history cah ON cac.compbankref = cah.histcompref
),
cohort_analysis AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.cohort_quarter, 
        dn.is_digital_native, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT cc.clientref) AS cohort_size, 
        AVG(es.engagement_score) AS avg_engagement_score, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN es.engagement_score > 0.7 THEN cc.clientref END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT cc.clientref) AS high_engagement_percentage
    FROM customer_cohorts cc
    LEFT JOIN digital_natives dn ON cc.clientref = dn.bankexpref
    LEFT JOIN engagement_scores es ON cc.clientref = es.clientref
    GROUP BY cc.cohort_quarter, dn.is_digital_native
)
SELECT 
    ca.cohort_quarter, 
    ca.is_digital_native, 
    ca.cohort_size, 
    ca.avg_engagement_score, 
    ca.high_engagement_percentage
FROM cohort_analysis ca
ORDER BY ca.cohort_quarter, ca.is_digital_native DESC;

WITH tenure_quartiles AS (
    SELECT 
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY tenureyrs) AS tenure_quartile
    FROM core_record
),
customer_cohorts AS (
    SELECT 
        cr.clientref, 
        tq.tenure_quartile AS cohort_quarter
    FROM core_record cr
    JOIN tenure_quartiles tq ON TRUE
),
digital_natives AS (
    SELECT 
        bat.bankexpref, 
        CASE 
            WHEN cidb.chaninvdatablock->>'onlineuse' = 'High' 
            AND cidb.chaninvdatablock->>'mobileuse' = 'High' THEN TRUE 
            ELSE FALSE 
        END AS is_digital_native
    FROM bank_and_transactions bat
    JOIN expenses_and_assets eaa ON bat.bankexpref = eaa.expemplref
    JOIN employment_and_income eai ON eaa.expemplref = eai.emplcoreref
    JOIN core_record cr ON eai.emplcoreref = cr.coreregistry
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT chaninvdatablock
    ) AS cidb
),
engagement_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        cr.clientref, 
        -- Assuming 'chanusescore' is the engagement score
        cah.chanusescore AS engagement_score
    FROM core_record cr
    JOIN employment_and_income eai ON cr.coreregistry = eai.emplcoreref
    JOIN expenses_and_assets eaa ON eai.emplcoreref = eaa.expemplref
    JOIN bank_and_transactions bat ON eaa.expemplref = bat.bankexpref
    JOIN credit_and_compliance cac ON bat.bankexpref = cac.compbankref
    JOIN credit_accounts_and_history cah ON cac.compbankref = cah.histcompref
),
cohort_analysis AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.cohort_quarter, 
        dn.is_digital_native, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT cc.clientref) AS cohort_size, 
        AVG(es.engagement_score) AS avg_engagement_score, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN es.engagement_score > 0.7 THEN cc.clientref END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT cc.clientref) AS high_engagement_percentage
    FROM customer_cohorts cc
    LEFT JOIN digital_natives dn ON cc.clientref = dn.bankexpref
    LEFT JOIN engagement_scores es ON cc.clientref = es.clientref
    GROUP BY cc.cohort_quarter, dn.is_digital_native
)
SELECT 
    ca.cohort_quarter, 
    ca.is_digital_native, 
    ca.cohort_size, 
    ca.avg_engagement_score, 
    ca.high_engagement_percentage
FROM cohort_analysis ca
ORDER BY ca.cohort_quarter, ca.is_digital_native DESC;
